verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of local development with your own editor or of syncing changes back, such as Git integration, a CLI or file sync. The only related item is a community report that local git commits conflicted with the agent's git operations and got stuck, which suggests the workflow is unreliable rather than documented. The Desktop App and MCP server are adjacent features and do not provide this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can work on the app locally with my own editor and tooling and push changes back to the platform
